issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) for a11y compliance.

critical_code_review_comments: backend server.py: POST /api/projects returns 200; consider 201 Created per REST convention (not blocking).
backend server.py: DELETE /api/projects/{pid} always returns {ok:true} even if the id doesn't exist (idempotent, but no 404 signal). Acceptable, just note.
PUT /api/projects/{pid} performs upsert — good for autosave resilience.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded from all responses (verified).
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly (no hardcoded URLs found).
